answer: Each identity must maintain one distinct postpaid mobile line, verified monthly by a carrier-signed bill and two random voice callbacks on separate days, with its number tied to a terrace plot on a public ridge registry marked by a cedar tag. Lines cannot share an account, device, or payment card. Running 1,000 Sybils needs 1,000 separate carrier contracts at $30 each monthly ($30,000), plus activation fees and a 4-coin bond forfeited per line reused or callback missed.
